operatorMessage:
# RecallWeave Hosted Baseline Next Run

Status: READY_FOR_OWNER_REVIEW
Scope: owner-review-not-public-launch
Ready for owner review: yes
Public launch allowed: no
Planner authorizes public claims: no

## Evidence State

- Hosted: hosted-supermemory, fixture=false, metricsOnly=true, privacyLeaks=0, quality=0
- RecallWeave: recallweave, fixture=false, metricsOnly=true, privacyLeaks=0, quality=0.1212
- Comparison: win=true, strictEvidence=true, reviewers=2

## Blocks

- owner-block: Evidence is ready for owner review. The planner still does not authorize public launch.

## Commands

### print-template

Print the aggregate-only hosted result schema before any live provider call.

```bash
npm exec --yes pnpm@10.23.0 -- baseline:preflight -- --print-template --output /tmp/recallweave-hosted-baseline-template.json
```

### fixture-shape-check

Validate the local parser and gate behavior without using a hosted provider.

```bash
npm exec --yes pnpm@10.23.0 -- baseline:next-run -- --fixture
```

### compare-matched-results

Compare hosted and RecallWeave aggregate result files before review. This still cannot publish a claim by itself.

```bash
npm exec --yes pnpm@10.23.0 -- baseline:compare -- --hosted /tmp/recallweave-hosted-baseline-result.json --recallweave /tmp/recallweave-result.json --output /tmp/recallweave-baseline-comparison.json
```

### package-review-evidence

Package only aggregate hosted, local, comparison, and preflight files for reviewer intake.

```bash
npm exec --yes pnpm@10.23.0 -- baseline:packet -- --hosted /tmp/recallweave-hosted-baseline-result.json --recallweave /tmp/recallweave-result.json --comparison /tmp/recallweave-baseline-comparison.json --preflight /tmp/recallweave-hosted-baseline-preflight.json --strict-real --output /tmp/recallweave-baseline-evidence-packet.zip
```

### collect-reviewer-approvals

Validate two independent reviewer approval artifacts against the exact metrics-only packet. This accepts Claude, Codex, Gemini, DeepSeek, or another reviewer only through sanitized JSON approval files.

```bash
npm exec --yes pnpm@10.23.0 -- baseline:reviewer-intake -- --packet /tmp/recallweave-baseline-evidence-packet.zip --comparison /tmp/recallweave-baseline-comparison.json --strict-target --review <reviewer-a-approval.json> --review <reviewer-b-approval.json> --output /tmp/recallweave-reviewer-approval-report.json
```

### rerun-reviewed-comparison

Rerun the aggregate comparison with the reviewer approval report bound to the packet before any public comparison language moves to owner review.

```bash
npm exec --yes pnpm@10.23.0 -- baseline:compare -- --hosted /tmp/recallweave-hosted-baseline-result.json --recallweave /tmp/recallweave-result.json --reviewer-approval-report /tmp/recallweave-reviewer-approval-report.json --output /tmp/recallweave-baseline-comparison.json
```

## Pass Criteria

- hosted and RecallWeave results are non-fixture
- both results are metrics-only and privacy-clean
- same dataset slice, query-set hash, scoring-code hash, judge model, and answer model
- every query has at least one expected result id or expected content hash
- querySetEvidence.publicBenchmarkReady is true for both runs
- source-match preflight proves every reviewed query has at least one collectable expected ref in the local RecallWeave source
- source-alignment gate proves the hosted label and local container map align and matchedBaselineRunAllowed is true
- source-gap plan reports READY_FOR_MATCHED_BASELINE before hosted collection, or a blocked repair path if not ready
- private hosted mirror is created locally with 0600 files before source-match and local-arm export when hosted history is the source
- RecallWeave local response export applies a context-token budget before comparison claims
- hosted container discovery emits hashed candidates only and any private raw-label map, env file, or query set stays local
- any auto-authored private query set was locally reviewed before collection
- latency, cost, P@1, recall@5, recall@10, NDCG@10, quality, and context-token fields present
- RecallWeave beats hosted baseline without any quality metric regressing more than the comparison gate allows
- two independent reviewers approve the setup and result through baseline:reviewer-intake before any public comparison language
- owner approval remains required for public launch or visibility changes

Attach only aggregate result files, discovery output, the query-set author report, the query-set inspection report, hosted mirror report, source-match, source-alignment, and source-gap reports, the comparison, preflight, baseline packet zip, and reviewer approval report. Do not attach raw memories, transcripts, prompts, answers, credentials, private paths, private container maps, private env files, private query sets, cookies, or unredacted diagnostics.
